title: Universal UI Element Id System
description: Give every UI element a consistent, dot-separated camelCased id (e.g. framework.navbar, ui.introduction.next). Ids are logical/renderer-abstract (core contract derives them; each renderer maps to its own element — React DOM id attribute, wgpu hit-target control_id). Normalize existing hyphenated/kebab stragglers (framework.display.save-label, world-orbit-projection, ${windowId}-action-${actionId}), remove the competing kebab data-testid convention, make id required across all ui/js/react component props (ElementBaseProps), and redesign IntroductionAnchor (framework/core/rs/lib.rs) so every anchor variant derives a canonical logical element id — replacing the current mixed [data-slot]/[id$=...]/[data-active-tab-id] selector resolution in introductionAnchorSelector (ui/js/react/index.tsx) with uniform [id="..."] resolution, and letting the introduction ("glass") system name which elements are above the glass and visible via the existing label pipeline (useIdLabel/humanizeControlId). Dynamic rows (chat messages, tree rows) use semantic keys when available, else label-normalized segments, else index fallback. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/ui-every-single-ui-melodic-wirth.md. Prior analysis: .repo/🎫/25/11/24/UI-ID-SYSTEM-ANALYSIS/ticket.md (compose/sketchpad scoped — reference only, not reopened).
